create_dictionary: create a dictionary mapping words to ids from a list of tokenized sentences with optional frequency threshold
get_wordvec: get word vectors from a fasttext or glove vector file filtered to a given word-to-id vocabulary
run_senteval_bow: run SentEval evaluation on 25 transfer tasks using bag-of-words embeddings with fasttext vectors
batcher_bow_embeddings: batch tokenized sentences into mean-pooled 300-dimensional word vector embeddings
prepare_senteval_params: prepare SentEval params by building a word vocabulary and loading word vectors for embedding-based classification
